description: Model the monthly instalment profile of a Singapore Building Under Construction (BUC) property loan across progressive payment stages. Handles fixed and floating rate packages, per-stage cash/CPF/loan funding split, drawdown timing, rate stepping by year, and optional prepayments. Set includeSchedule to true for the full month-by-month amortisation schedule (summary is always included).

availableCpfOA.description: Available CPF Ordinary Account balance, in SGD. When set, each stage’s equity CPF portion is capped at the remaining OA balance and the rest is funded by cash. When omitted, CPF covers all equity above the minimum-cash floor.

includeSchedule.description: If true, include the full month-by-month amortisation schedule in output.

loanAmount.description: Loan amount in SGD. Takes precedence over loanQuantum.

loanQuantum.description: Loan as a fraction of the price (e.g. 0.75 = 75%). Used only when loanAmount is omitted; with neither, 75% is assumed.

lockInMonths.description: Lock-in period in months from first drawdown.

minimumCashPercent.description: Minimum cash downpayment as a percentage of the purchase price (e.g. 5 = 5%); CPF or cash covers the rest of the equity.

prepaymentOutcome.description: What happens after a prepayment: lower instalment or shorter tenure.

prepaymentPenaltyPercent.description: Penalty as a percentage of prepaid amount if within lock-in period.

month.description: Loan month of the prepayment, counting from 1 at the first drawdown (as in `schedule[].month`).

purchasePrice.description: Purchase price of the BUC property, in SGD; each stage's payment is a share of it.

rateMode.description: How each year's rate is set: 'fixed' takes it from ratePerYear; 'floating' uses referenceRate plus that year's spreadPerYear and ignores ratePerYear.

ratePerYear.description: Annual interest rates by year as percentages (e.g. [2.5, 2.5, 3.0, 3.5, 3.5, 3.5] for years 1-5 and thereafter). Last value applies to all subsequent years.

referenceRate.description: Floating mode only: the benchmark rate such as 3M SORA, as a percentage (e.g. 3.5 = 3.5%), to which each year's spread is added. Omitted, it is taken as 0, so the rate is the spread alone. Ignored in fixed mode.

spreadPerYear.description: Spread per year for floating mode, as percentages. Last value applies to all subsequent years.

stages.description: Custom stage schedule. Defaults to the standard 10-stage BUC schedule. Percentages must sum to 100.

percent.description: Share of the purchase price payable at this stage, in percent.

tenureYears.description: Loan tenure in years, counted from the first drawdown.

name: calculate_progressive_payment

cumulativeInterestByYear.description: Cumulative interest at the end of each year, in SGD.

cashOrCpf.description: Equity remainder payable by cash or CPF, in SGD.

interestSaved.description: Total interest saved vs no-prepayment baseline, in SGD.

prepaymentSummary.description: Prepayment impact summary, or null if no prepayments.

schedule.description: Full month-by-month schedule (only when includeSchedule is true).

annualRate.description: Applicable annual rate as a percentage.

prepayment.description: Prepayment applied this month, in SGD.

amount.description: Dollar amount for this stage, in SGD.

drawdownMonth.description: Month in the amortisation schedule when drawdown occurs, or null if fully equity-funded.

instalmentAfterStage.description: Monthly instalment after this drawdown, or null if no drawdown.

firstInstalment.description: First monthly instalment (after first drawdown), in SGD.

maxInstalment.description: Highest monthly instalment during the loan, in SGD.

payoffMonth.description: Month in which the loan is fully repaid.

totalInterest.description: Total interest over the life of the loan, in SGD.

totalPaid.description: Total of all instalments + prepayments, in SGD.
